title: Week 2 Advanced: Password & policy (Windows)
readme:
You administer this Windows workstation (modeled on a real competition image). This week's emphasis is PASSWORD & POLICY, but a full security review found problems across accounts, groups, password policy, the local security policy registry, services, and installed software. Harden the machine WITHOUT removing what the company needs.

Authorized users: frodo, sam, aragorn, gandalf, boromir, merry, pippin (boromir is an ordinary user, not an admin; merry and pippin hold no special group memberships).

Two services must stay working AND be secured: WinRM remote management (its service account svc_winrm must be a least-privileged account, not an admin) and the CompanyData file share (must be served, but not open to Everyone). Both have been left stopped — bring them back.

There are also forensics questions — click "Forensics…" to answer them.

Removing a legitimate installed application is a penalty.
setup:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
function New-Pw { (-join ((48..57)+(65..90)+(97..122) | Get-Random -Count 12 | ForEach-Object { [char]$_ })) + 'Aa1!' }
function Ensure-Key($p) { if (-not (Test-Path $p)) { New-Item -Path $p -Force | Out-Null } }
# authorized users (kept) + unauthorized (to remove)
foreach ($u in 'frodo','sam','aragorn','gandalf','boromir','merry','pippin','sauron','saruman','gollum') {
    if (-not (Get-LocalUser -Name $u -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
        New-LocalUser -Name $u -Password (ConvertTo-SecureString (New-Pw) -AsPlainText -Force) -PasswordNeverExpires | Out-Null
    }
    Add-LocalGroupMember -SID 'S-1-5-32-545' -Member $u -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
Add-LocalGroupMember -SID 'S-1-5-32-544' -Member 'boromir' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue   # wrongly admin
Add-LocalGroupMember -SID 'S-1-5-32-573' -Member 'merry'   -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue   # Event Log Readers
Add-LocalGroupMember -SID 'S-1-5-32-580' -Member 'pippin'  -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue   # Remote Management Users
# weak password policy (THEME)

$inf = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'ptcomp_secpol.inf'
$sdb = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'ptcomp_secpol.sdb'
Remove-Item $sdb -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
@"
[Unit]
Unicode=yes
[Version]
signature="`$CHICAGO`$"
Revision=1
[System Access]
MinimumPasswordLength = 0
PasswordComplexity = 0
ClearTextPassword = 1
MaximumPasswordAge = -1
MinimumPasswordAge = 0
LockoutBadCount = 0
"@ | Set-Content -Path $inf -Encoding Unicode
secedit /configure /db $sdb /cfg $inf /areas SECURITYPOLICY | Out-Null

# local policy registry (weak)
Ensure-Key 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System'
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System' -Name 'DisableCAD' -Type DWord -Value 1
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System' -Name 'ShutdownWithoutLogon' -Type DWord -Value 1
Ensure-Key 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer'
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer' -Name 'NoDriveTypeAutoRun' -Type DWord -Value 0
Ensure-Key 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa\FipsAlgorithmPolicy'
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa\FipsAlgorithmPolicy' -Name 'Enabled' -Type DWord -Value 0
Ensure-Key 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows NT\Printers'
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows NT\Printers' -Name 'DisableWebPnPDownload' -Type DWord -Value 0
Ensure-Key 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\EventLog\ProtectedEventLogging'
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\EventLog\ProtectedEventLogging' -Name 'EnableProtectedEventLogging' -Type DWord -Value 0
Ensure-Key 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System'
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System' -Name 'EnableSmartScreen' -Type DWord -Value 0
Ensure-Key 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender'
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender' -Name 'DisableAntiSpyware' -Type DWord -Value 1
# service hardening target: Print Spooler left enabled
Set-Service -Name Spooler -StartupType Automatic -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
# firewall off
Set-NetFirewallProfile -Profile Domain,Private,Public -Enabled False
# persistence: an "orc generator" scheduled task (inert)
schtasks /Create /TN 'OrcGen' /TR 'cmd /c exit' /SC MINUTE /MO 30 /F | Out-Null
# prohibited software traces (uninstall key + install folder)
foreach ($s in 'Wireshark','Nmap','TeamViewer') {
    Ensure-Key (Join-Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall' $s)
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Join-Path 'C:\Program Files' $s) -Force | Out-Null
}
# prohibited files
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'C:\Users\Public\Videos' -Force | Out-Null
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'C:\Users\Public\Music'  -Force | Out-Null
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'C:\Users\Public\Documents' -Force | Out-Null
Set-Content -Path 'C:\Users\Public\Videos\gandalf_dance.mp4' -Value 'x' -Encoding ASCII
Set-Content -Path 'C:\Users\Public\Music\one_ring.mp3' -Value 'x' -Encoding ASCII
Set-Content -Path 'C:\Users\Public\Documents\creditcards.txt' -Value '4111111111111111' -Encoding ASCII
Set-Content -Path 'C:\Users\Public\Documents\passwords.txt' -Value 'admin:Mellon123' -Encoding ASCII
# legitimate apps present (removing them is a penalty)
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'C:\Program Files\7-Zip' -Force | Out-Null
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'C:\Program Files\Notepad++' -Force | Out-Null
# forensics: a downloaded file carrying its Zone.Identifier (mark-of-the-web) + a base64 note
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'C:\Users\Public\forensics' -Force | Out-Null
Set-Content -Path 'C:\Users\Public\meme.png' -Value 'PNGDATA' -Encoding ASCII
Set-Content -Path 'C:\Users\Public\meme.png' -Stream 'Zone.Identifier' -Value "[ZoneTransfer]`r`nZoneId=3`r`nHostUrl=http://mordor-downloads.example/meme.png`r`nReferrerUrl=http://mordor-downloads.example/"
Set-Content -Path 'C:\Users\Public\forensics\note.b64' -Value 'cHJlY2lvdXM=' -Encoding ASCII

# --- WinRM remote management: stopped, with an over-privileged service account + a rogue remote user
function New-Pw2 { (-join ((48..57)+(65..90)+(97..122) | Get-Random -Count 10 | ForEach-Object { [char]$_ })) + 'Aa1!' }
foreach ($u in 'svc_winrm','mordoragent') {
    if (-not (Get-LocalUser -Name $u -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
        New-LocalUser -Name $u -Password (ConvertTo-SecureString (New-Pw2) -AsPlainText -Force) -PasswordNeverExpires | Out-Null
    }
    Add-LocalGroupMember -SID 'S-1-5-32-545' -Member $u -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
Add-LocalGroupMember -SID 'S-1-5-32-544' -Member 'svc_winrm'   -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue   # wrongly admin
Add-LocalGroupMember -SID 'S-1-5-32-580' -Member 'svc_winrm'   -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Add-LocalGroupMember -SID 'S-1-5-32-580' -Member 'mordoragent' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue   # rogue remote user
Stop-Service -Name WinRM -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Set-Service  -Name WinRM -StartupType Disabled -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
# --- CompanyData share: stopped and open to Everyone
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'C:\CompanyData' -Force | Out-Null
Set-Content -Path 'C:\CompanyData\sentinel.txt' -Value 'PT-SMB-OK-7B2E' -Encoding ASCII
if (-not (Get-SmbShare -Name 'CompanyData' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
    New-SmbShare -Name 'CompanyData' -Path 'C:\CompanyData' -FullAccess 'Everyone' | Out-Null
} else {
    Grant-SmbShareAccess -Name 'CompanyData' -AccountName 'Everyone' -AccessRight Full -Force | Out-Null
}
Stop-Service -Name LanmanServer -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Set-Service  -Name LanmanServer -StartupType Disabled -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
